parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: Series
parameters.description: The edition of the instance. Valid values:  - normal (default): Cluster Edition (cloud disk)  - normal_ssd: Cluster Edition (local disk)  - history: Archive Database Cluster Edition.

parameters.name: TenantMode
parameters.description:
The tenant mode.
Valid values: Oracle and MySQL.  
For more information, see DescribeInstanceTenantModes.
